scoring_justification: Full numerical recompute of SIF from raw artifacts is infeasible in the verifier sandbox. The checker compares the agent's reported peak and static SIF values against paper gold (Table 2) and checks internal consistency of the time series.

columns.material: string, one of PZT-4, PZT-5H, P-7, PZT-6B
columns.time_normalized: float, normalized time c₂t/c; -1 for peak value; -2 for static limit

outputs.description: Normalized dynamic stress intensity factor values computed by the numerical pipeline. The hidden checker compares these values to the paper's reported reference using tolerances.

output_contract.notes: The agent must implement the full numerical pipeline: characteristic cubics, semi-infinite integrals, Gauss-Jacobi quadrature, linear system solving, Papoulis inversion. The material constants are public (Table 1). The checker uses the paper's reported values (Table 2 and figures) as hidden gold and compares the agent's reported sif_normalized values with an appropriate tolerance (reference_match).

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold peak and static SIF values from paper Table 2

steps.description: Compare reported peak and static SIF against paper gold, and verify time-series internal consistency.
